archetypes.name: dyn-registry-dispatch
archetypes.rationale: Registry shape and facade repoints can silently break lazy dispatch or quiet-mode.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect python/larch/cli.py _REGISTRY three-tuples and main() unpacking. Confirm machine_stdout True rows still set LARCH_QUIET_DISABLE before import, False rows do not, and no design_lifecycle, review_pipeline, or run_logs facade remains on the 39 repointed keys. Check that _MACHINE_STDOUT_KEYS is derived only from True rows. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
